mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：【分级产品取“产品名称+子产品名称”；普通产品取“产品名称”】 PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） SETDATE：产品成立日期 */ SELECT RPI.PROD_ID prodId, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END titleName, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||RPI.PROD_NAME ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName, RPI2.PROD_RE regCode, RPI.SET_DATE setDate FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 P_PROD_ID:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'
SELECT * FROM DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN WHERE DATA_STATUS = 'E' AND PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND SETT_DATE = TO_DATE(#{settDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
SELECT * FROM REP_PROD_INDEX WHERE STATUS = 'E' AND PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND VALUE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{settDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') openStartDate, TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') openEndDate, TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_START_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') openStartDate||'至'||TO_CHAR(DPP.OPEN_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') openDurationDate, TO_CHAR(DPP.COLLINGOFF_PERIOD,'yyyy-MM-dd') collingoffPeriod FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO,DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP WHERE INFO.STATUS = 'E' AND DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.OPEN_END_DATE>TO_DATE(#{settDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY DPP.OPEN_END_DATE ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT ,PLAN.SETT_DATE /*基准日*/ ,PLAN.PAYMENT_DATE /*红利发放日*/ FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN DIS_PROD_BONUSPLAN PLAN ON PLAN.PROD_ID=INFO.PROD_ID AND PLAN.DATA_STATUS='E' AND PLAN.SETT_DATE=TO_DATE(#{settDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND PLAN.BONUS_MODE = '01' WHERE INFO.STATUS='E' AND INFO.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
